POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.

PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory within the persistent volume. Do not change on an existing database.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Generated private Redis/Valkey password, or a reference to that password. Keep secret.

REDIS_URL.description: Private authenticated Redis/Valkey connection URL. Automatically assembled from service references.

RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER.description: RabbitMQ user created on first initialization. Keep aligned with the NuQ connection URL.

RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS.description: Generated RabbitMQ password. Preserve it with the persistent broker data.

RABBITMQ_NODENAME.description: Stable RabbitMQ node identity for persisted queue data. Keep rabbit@localhost across redeployments.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

MAX_CONCURRENT_PAGES.description: Maximum concurrent renderer pages. Starts at 2 to limit browser memory usage.

ALLOW_LOCAL_WEBHOOKS.description: Allow webhook requests to local/private targets. Keep false to restrict access to internal networks.

BLOCK_MEDIA.description: Block browser media downloads to reduce resource usage during scraping.

HOST.description: HTTP bind address. Keep 0.0.0.0 so Railway can reach the service.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

ENV.description: Firecrawl runtime mode. Keep local for this self-hosted deployment.

USE_DB_AUTHENTICATION.description: Internal Firecrawl database authentication toggle. Keep false with this private API and authenticated public gateway.

REDIS_URL.description: Private authenticated Redis/Valkey connection URL. Automatically assembled from service references.

REDIS_RATE_LIMIT_URL.description: Private Redis URL used for Firecrawl rate limiting. References the authenticated redis service.

POSTGRES_HOST.description: Private PostgreSQL hostname. Automatically resolved from the postgres service.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.

NUQ_RABBITMQ_URL.description: Private RabbitMQ connection URL for the NuQ queue, using generated broker credentials.

PLAYWRIGHT_MICROSERVICE_URL.description: Private browser renderer scrape endpoint. Automatically references the browser service.

NUM_WORKERS_PER_QUEUE.description: Workers per Firecrawl queue. Increase after measuring CPU, memory, and queue latency.

CRAWL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS.description: Concurrent requests per crawl. Starts at 2; respect target-site rate limits.

MAX_CONCURRENT_JOBS.description: Maximum simultaneous Firecrawl jobs. Increase only when memory and queue latency permit.

BROWSER_POOL_SIZE.description: Firecrawl browser pool size. Starts at 2; increase only after measuring memory use.

EXTRACT_WORKER_PORT.description: Internal extraction-worker port. Keep the supplied port and leave it private.

WORKER_PORT.description: Internal Firecrawl worker HTTP port. Keep the supplied port and do not expose it publicly.

HARNESS_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum Firecrawl harness startup wait in milliseconds. Increase if cold starts need more time.

BULL_AUTH_KEY.description: Generated secret protecting Firecrawl queue administration. Keep private.

ALLOW_LOCAL_WEBHOOKS.description: Allow webhook requests to local/private targets. Keep false to restrict access to internal networks.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

API_KEY.description: Generated API authentication key, or a reference to the shared internal API key. Keep private and preserve matching references.

UPSTREAM_URL.description: Private Firecrawl API URL used by the public gateway. Keep the api service reference.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
